andhra.headline: Tension in Pithapuram as JSP councillors differ over vice-chairman pick
andhra.summary: Jana Sena Party Councillors, supporters opposed the party’s decision to elect Bojja Venkateswara Rao as Pithapuram Municipal Vice-Chairman on the grounds of being a newcomer to the party.

andhra.headline: SEC directs local body poll candidates to file expenditure returns
andhra.summary: Candidates in 99 ULBs must submit accounts by December 18 and those in Chirala by December 21; failure will invite three-year disqualification and loss of office for elected candidates

andhra.headline: Andhra Pradesh initiates advance procurement of medicines for six months
andhra.summary: Health Department have shifted from procuring three-month stock in advance after the CAG report flags shortcomings in the system followed between 2018 and 2022

andhra.headline: Andhra’s first semiconductor plant to come up near Visakhapatnam with ₹2,387 crore investment
andhra.summary: The chip assembly and testing unit at Tarluvada is the State’s first project under the India Semiconductor Mission and will create 1,000 jobs

india.headline: India maps landslide susceptibility as part of shift from post-disaster relief to landslide management
india.summary: Mapping exercise covers 4.3 lakh square km; focus now on prevention, preparedness, risk reduction, says Science Minister; calls for interdisciplinary research, continuous monitoring to minimise impact

india.headline: NIA quizzes Mamata TMC MLA in connection with April 1 violence during SIR
india.summary: Sabina Yeasmin and her husband appeared before NIA officials and claimed they had no knowledge of the alleged attacks and violence on April 1 and that they were not present at the site

india.headline: Delhi Police bust cybercrime syndicate that defrauded victims of over ₹20 crore via malicious APK files
india.summary: Officials received over 1,300 complaints in the past three months relating to bank account takeovers and cyber fraud through APK files

india.headline: Rule of law needed, not ‘Rule of Power’: Netherlands Foreign Minister Berendsen on Trilateral Summit
india.summary: Berendsen holds talks with EAM Jaishankar, says Europe and India must end dependencies on global powers for energy, security and technology

india.summary: The MLAs of the Congress, the Viduthalai Chiruthaigal Katchi, and the Indian Union Muslim League attended the meeting, besides the representatives of the CPI(M) and the CPI

usa.headline: Let's talk turkey: Here's how Thanksgiving meal costs have changed this year
usa.summary: Grocery costs have been on the rise, but food-price analysts say it's unclear if you'll spend more on the Thanksgiving meal this year. Some people are deciding not to host or are hosting fewer guests.

usa.headline: Seniors embrace Tesla automated driving technology despite questions about safety
usa.summary: Older drivers are using Tesla's automated driving technology to stay on the road longer. But safety experts warn the company may be over-selling what its cars can do.

usa.headline: As holidays approach, food banks face increased demand
usa.summary: Under pressure from higher grocery prices, more people turn to food banks. NPR's Steve Inskeep speaks with Linda Nageotte of Feeding America, a nonprofit running a network of food banks.

usa.headline: Army reschedules detonation of toxic explosives in Iowa for Wednesday
usa.summary: The U.S. Army has rescheduled the detonation of about five tons of bomb-making material in Iowa to Wednesday to accommodate weather and "mitigation measures."

usa.headline: Do not feed the animals. Vets explain why hats, coins and shoes can be deadly
usa.summary: It's not easy to retrieve foreign objects from animals once ingested. Some things can be grabbed using an endoscope. But if an item gets far into the intestinal tract, surgery isn't always possible.

usa.headline: What it's like at a climate conference as talks collapse
usa.summary: After two weeks of negotiations, international climate talks fail to reach an agreement. NPR's Rachel Waldholz was in Turkey for the conference.

world.headline: What failure of COP31 reveals about a divided world
world.summary: Interests of oil-producing countries, a US boycott and a dispute over finance may have torpedoed climate talks.

world.headline: Israeli attacks have turned Gaza into 'toxic wasteland', Oxfam says
world.summary: The report says there are signs of possible contamination across almost all of Gaza as a result of Israel's actions.

world.headline: The rise and fall and rise again of Jensen Huang
world.summary: Days after resigning while mired in scandal of extra-marital affairs, Nvidia's Jensen Huang is making a remarkable return.

world.headline: Russian warship hit by Ukrainian drones in Libya, Zelensky says
world.summary: The Kremlin warns of an "escalation of tensions in the region", but declines to comment directly on the attacks in Libya.

world.headline: Mexican soldiers attacked in wake of drug lord's arrest
world.summary: Eight suspects are arrested after firing on soldiers trying to re-establish order following the arrest of 'El Chapo Isidro'.

world.headline: Nigeria's president says he is also hit by water and power cuts plaguing country
world.summary: Bola Tinubu says he was shaving last week when the water cut out - an experience familiar to many Nigerians.
